title: review-question/v1
description: targets/<id>/review/questions/<id>.yaml (F26-R1, R7; D-9 v3.39): a question to the intent signer, in mathematics and never in Lean, phrased as the hypothesis it tests, with what raised it — a proved disagreement between clusters, a concept value candidates disagree on, a mutant every test passed, a shape the pairs could not settle, or a signer's send-back. Open until an answer record names it. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

target.description: the target the record is filed under

question.description: the question in words, phrased as the hypothesis ("Suppose 5 were the only prime. Would the conjecture be satisfied at n = 2?")

ref.description: the exhibit, pair, mutant or signature record that raised it

asked_to.description: the role asked; only the intent signer answers

id.description: the record's id, lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens; a candidate's is `c-<8 hex>` of its Lean's sha256, a test's `t-<8 hex>`, a question's `q-<n>`, an exhibit's `e-<8 hex>`
